pretreatments.description: Microwave pretreatment (MP) involves high-power microwave irradiation using an IFB-30SC2 oven. Power levels tested ranged from 90 to 720 W, with a treatment time from 1 to 60 minutes. Analysis identified 15 minutes at 450 W as the optimal point for maximum soluble organic release. The study evaluated specific energy (MSE) with optimal values found between 20250 and 32400 kJ/kg TS.

Surfactant microwave pretreatment (SMP) combines microwave irradiation with Surfactant dodecylbenzene sulfonate (SDBS) in a 1:50 ratio of substrate-to-water. SDBS concentrations were tested at levels ranging from 0.005 to 0.5 g/g TS. The surfactant lowers interfacial surface tension to enhance substrate disintegration, with optimal liquefaction efficiency of 19.5% recorded at 0.04 g/g TS.
